name: promise-toast
title: Promise Toast
description: One toast that follows a whole request: a spinner while it runs, then a drawn check or a shaking ×, a title that rolls to the outcome, View or Retry, and a bar that times the auto-dismiss
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/promise-toast · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/promise-toast.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: toast promise, loading toast, async toast, publishing toast, retry toast
